dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you, {NICKNAME}. What's going on? Is something wrong?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's all thanks to you that we managed to get to the Eternal Oasis. Without your help, we would have never been able to open the path.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I don't even know how to thank you... Next time we start a bonfire, we should talk about this by the flames. It'll be just like...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Just like that time with Azariq... Ah...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: ...That traitorous dog...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm sorry...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: You've got nothing to be sorry about... I wasn't mad at you.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Honestly, the Matriarch had already warned me to keep my guard up before we left. I might be careless — well, just a bit. But I'm not stupid.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: The schematics of that ancient machine... Not sharing that with the tribe was a crime. The moment I realized that, I started suspecting him.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: What I didn't expect, though, was his willingness to keep pursuing his schemes even after all the time we spent around each other... He really thought he could manipulate me...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I feel disgusted just thinking about it...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Thankfully, Matriarch Babel has always been on my side. I believe that she can help the tribe find prosperity again.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: She will. Absolutely.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: And you! You've always been in my corner as well!

choices.text: Yeah. I'm a Jeht-person too, you know!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Jeht-person? That sounds so... weird. Like a nickname Paimon might give.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: #But seriously, thanks, {NICKNAME}... Really.

choices.text: What if I come into conflict with the Matriarch?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Ha! You're kidding. You're the Tanit's esteemed guest, the one who brought the Mother of the Jinn back and found the path to the Eternal Oasis...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I can't think of any reason why you and the Matriarch might come into conflict.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yeah, so... If you ever need my help, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Back from Gurabad, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Is there something you need? Things have been quite busy back here with the Tanit...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yes, I heard. She left and went back to that cursed place.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hmph. She was peacocking around the whole time, driving me up the wall... and now she's finally silent. What a relief.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Still, she did help us a great deal... Come to think of it, what do you think she'll find there? And if there's nothing to be found... I wonder if she'll feel lonely... Like how we felt lonely?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's a shame that I couldn't go with you...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Agh, it's nothing major. Can't talk about it right now, though...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's about something within the tribe, and maybe those northerners too. I don't know the details either, to be honest.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: However... Ah...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: However...!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Agh. Sorry. The reason I'm acting like this... What I mean to say is... If I...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: No! I—If you meet with danger, then believe me when I say that I'll always be there to help you.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: And if I'm the one in trouble... I believe you'll come for me too, won't you?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Alright... Thanks. You should... keep an eye out for enemies, okay?

choices.text: Of course, but don't forget to pay once I'm done.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hmph... Don't dodge the question with that mercenary talk.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Just... be careful.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: We're lucky you took that stuff from those northerners. Benben is recovering and looking better already.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Almost as good as when we first met it...

choices.text: Then, when you have the time...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yeah, we'll talk more when I have more time...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Oh, right! Right...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's nothing... If you run into any trouble, any danger at all, I'll be right at your side. So... Be careful.
